input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $16.50 deduction on order DD-48267, dated 2026-11-07. The reason given for the deduction was a missing item, the Peanut Butter Bowl. The order ticket for DD-48267 lists the Peanut Butter Bowl, which shows the item was part of the order as placed and prepared [DD-48267:ticket_lists_item]. The order was ready at 12:52 and was picked up at 12:55, three minutes later, so it was handed off promptly [DD-48267:pickup_handoff]. We understand these records do not show the bag contents, and we are sharing what they do show. Based on them, we respectfully ask that the $16.50 deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
